name: Shemariah
overview: Shemariah is a male biblical figure identified as a descendant of Harim. His notable characteristic is that he had married a foreign wife, as recorded in Ezra 10:32. There is no specific tribal affiliation or additional personal notes provided about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Shemariah means "YHWH guards, preserves," reflecting a theologically rich meaning connected to God's protection. This proper name is not indicated as being given directly by God, but it carries significant spiritual connotation.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Shemariah as a descendant of Harim. Beyond this lineage, no further family relationships are documented in the biblical text referenced.
scriptureSignificance: Shemariah's significance lies in his inclusion among those who had taken foreign wives, an issue addressed during the post-exilic community's efforts to maintain covenantal purity. His identification as a descendant of Harim places him within a priestly or Levitical family line, highlighting the gravity of the reforms being undertaken. This context underscores the biblical emphasis on obedience to God's commands and the importance of faithfulness within the community.
